evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Search/discovery is one capability; the identification and fingerprinting methods are alternative implementations of that single feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single music search/discovery feature based on profile data.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one feature for music search/discovery based on similar users.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: Still one content-similarity search/discovery feature; music and ringback tones are result types, not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Enriched metadata and image tags are inputs to one search/discovery feature; related artists, genres, and listening paths are benefits.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag availability is a direct consequence of one upload feature rather than an independently implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single viewing feature for video segment thumbnails.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: One information retrieval feature; video items and segments are subjects of that retrieval.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: One feature for retrieving information about perceptually similar video items and segments.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature based on similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single location-based content recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification and related information retrieval are independently implementable/testable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification and related information retrieval are independent features.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification and related information retrieval are independent features.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification and related information retrieval are independent features.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Picture taking/upload is one input feature; the recommendation is the stated benefit, not a separately requested feature.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Combines location tracking, map-based content access, and location-based alerts, which are independent capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single search feature using automatic speech recognition.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Viewing, validating, and editing segmentation are independently implementable operations.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction are separate capabilities that can be implemented and tested independently.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are distinct operations on videos and can be implemented or prioritized separately.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single audio-edit assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single content prefiltering feature for nudity.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single search-based prefiltering feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single automated validation feature for copyright infringement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata and tags are enumerated inputs to one prefiltering feature.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Single picture assessment feature; multiple quality dimensions and data sources are attributes of that assessment.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature for scientist prompting.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single classification feature for volunteer types.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single preclassification feature for Galaxy Zoo images.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature for empty/no-classifiable-animal images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Single image series detection feature for timestamping malfunction cases.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single species preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single attribute preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single animal count detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation and localization are alternative formulations of one plankton detection/localization capability.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature for empty Plankton Portal images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size and orientation are attributes of one plankton detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single plankton species preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis is the mechanism for one video-duration-reduction feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single event time detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Flooding, damage, shelters, and roads are enumerated examples of one important-feature detection capability.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer's classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single classification-weight assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact types are enumerated within one image-prefiltering feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single object detection feature; moving and transient are object attributes.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Noise and distracting sounds are types of unwanted audio within one removal feature.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single grouping feature for similar whale calls.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single whale-count identification feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single timing-detection feature for volunteer interruption.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Text, image, and video are modality alternatives within one interruption-decision feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single timing-detection feature for volunteer education.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Modality choices are alternatives within one education-decision feature.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single education-selection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single interesting-comment detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single timing-detection feature for Zoonibot comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single timing-detection feature for Zoonibot explanations.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single message-selection feature for Zoonibot.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single similarity-based grouping feature.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single project recommendation feature based on volunteer experience.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single article-summary viewing feature; reuse is the stated benefit.
